visual_identity.core_identity: Natural dungeon rats with pointed snouts, rounded ears, incisors, whiskers, low quadruped bodies, and long mostly hairless tails.
visual_identity.silhouette: Low rodent body, arched back, pointed snout, rounded ears, long tapering tail.
visual_identity.head_features: Long rat snout, rounded ears, small eyes, whiskers, visible incisors on foreground animals.
visual_identity.body_shape: Lean four-legged rodent anatomy with small forepaws and stronger hind legs.
visual_identity.surface: Short coarse fur indicated sparingly; tail mostly hairless.

accuracy_checks: reads as rat rather than generic furry beast
tail and rounded ears are visible
rodent posture remains low and quadrupedal

known_failure_modes.symptom: rat becomes cute with oversized round features
known_failure_modes.correction: lengthen snout, sharpen body proportions, and keep expression wary or hungry

known_failure_modes.symptom: rat develops canine body or paws
known_failure_modes.correction: restore low rodent body, small forepaws, rounded ears, and long naked tail
